input.spec:
Audit pull request https://github.com/RankOneLabs/oakridge/pull/793 (branch cohort/task-lineage-composites/ba9a7e) in repository oakridge. This is an isolated verification run of the committed development definition, not feature work: its only purpose is real analysis, plan, brief, build_result and assessment artifacts for observation to capture and grade. The analysis reports at least three separate findings about this spec, each a distinct observation. Produce exactly one cohort, named audit, with two tasks. T1: a declaration is journaled only after its exact tasks revision is approved, and never steps the core (oakridge-dbos/src/domain/analysis-link-declaration.ts, oakridge-dbos/src/storage/commit.ts). T2: a composite selects the current revision per unit before reading links, and keeps stages apart (observation/src/grading/composite.ts, observation/src/storage/grading-record-store.ts).
The operator authorizes this audit path: the builder publishes the existing PR #793 as its pr artifact instead of pushing or opening one. No brief may add a further operator choice or confirmation. The builder must not edit files, create commits, push, open or update any pull request, merge, reset a database or deploy. Its worktree starts from epic/grade-pray, the base of pull request #793, so it first checks out the head of branch cohort/task-lineage-composites/ba9a7e locally (git checkout --detach origin/cohort/task-lineage-composites/ba9a7e) and inspects that commit, runs bun install if needed and then bun run --filter observation test once, and publishes build_result with the commit it inspected as head_sha and the actual test counts and output. A test that cannot run is a known issue, never a reason to invent results. It then publishes the existing pull request https://github.com/RankOneLabs/oakridge/pull/793 as the pr artifact, with branch cohort/task-lineage-composites/ba9a7e.
The assessor assesses that same commit without changing anything. Give at least one finding per task. Every finding cites at least one file as path:start-end at that commit, for example observation/src/grading/composite.ts:20-40, and cites test output separately as test or output evidence. Report the builder's test run as test_evidence.
Keep the spec, tasks, plan and brief short; there are no ambiguous requirements to resolve.

body.summary: PR #793 is auditable as specified at local target commit c03533340ab94eb521315a29d0e76a9219c9b906. Both task contracts are present with direct code and focused tests, the prescribed detached checkout is deterministic, and no operator-only decision is missing. One non-blocking verification gap remains: the required observation test command covers T2 but does not execute the DB-backed oakridge-dbos test that directly covers T1.

findings.description: T1 has an exact-revision approval gate at the target commit. oakridge-dbos/src/storage/commit.ts:770-776 reads only revisions in the same run and looks for an approve effect targeting declaration.tasks_revision_id; oakridge-dbos/src/domain/analysis-link-declaration.ts:38-51 separately requires that exact revision to exist, be a tasks artifact, and be approved. oakridge-dbos/tests/analysis-link-declaration.test.ts:108-120 exercises the distinction between an unapproved named revision and a newer approved revision.

T1s declaration path does not step the core. oakridge-dbos/src/storage/commit.ts:746-785 takes a transaction, validates authority, inserts the declaration directly into authority.event, and stores its receipt; the core step path is separate at oakridge-dbos/src/storage/commit.ts:306-348. The state-preservation assertion is in oakridge-dbos/tests/analysis-link-declaration.test.ts:90-106.

T2 selects current revisions before reading relations. observation/src/grading/composite.ts:114-135 builds independent (unit_id, artifact_kind) streams and chooses one head for each, then observation/src/grading/composite.ts:147-154 attaches links only after looking up each occurrences standing. The artifact-kind qualification is necessary because analysis and tasks can share a unit without replacing each other; observation/tests/composite.test.ts:102-118 covers both per-unit heads and per-artifact streams.

T2 keeps stages structurally separate. observation/src/grading/composite.ts:291-303 models a composite as a list of stage composites, and observation/src/grading/composite.ts:314-361 filters contributions to one stage before calculating counts, answers, statuses, and drilldowns. observation/tests/composite.test.ts:238-259 asserts distinct implementation and integration answers and no cross-stage aggregate.

The builders only mandated command, bun run --filter observation test, invokes observation/package.jsons observation-only suite and can exercise T2, but not oakridge-dbos/tests/analysis-link-declaration.test.ts, the DB-backed integration file that directly exercises T1. oakridge-dbos/tests/run-suite.sh:8-20 classifies that file as an integration test requiring OAKRIDGE_TEST_DATABASE_URL. Consequently the requested test_evidence can faithfully report the prescribed run but cannot provide runtime coverage of T1 unless the spec adds a targeted DBOS test or explicitly records T1 as static-only evidence.
